tools.name: my_library
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the sessions they saved, their favourites or their own list. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: save_session
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to keep a session to come back to: save this, add it to my list, favourite it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: unsave_session
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a session taken off their saved list. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: like_session
tools.description: Use this when the user says how the session they just finished was: they liked it, or it was not for them. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: my_history
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what they listened to recently or how much time they have listened. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to carry on with the session they stopped part-way, or asks where they left off. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: my_badges
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their badges, how many days they listened this month or what they have earned. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: list_challenges
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about the listening challenge or any challenge they could join. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: join_challenge
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to join the listening challenge. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: challenge_today
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what today's challenge session is, or how they are doing in the challenge. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: schedule_session
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a reminder or a calendar entry for a session at a time of day: tonight at 9:30, every evening. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: set_preferences
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change how their sessions sound or are chosen: a voice, a language, a length, the music layer on or off, or Quiet mode. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: account_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to connect this chat to their 2hives app or website account so their progress is in one place. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: start_team_pilot
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to try 2hives with a work team or company and gives, or can give, a company name and work email. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for personal listening.

tools.name: get_sponsor_info
tools.description: Use this when an adult asks how a local business or community group can appear on 2hives, or what the sponsor packages are. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for personal listening.

tools.name: create_line_interest
tools.description: Use this when an adult says a named local business would like a short spoken sponsor line before sessions near it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for personal listening. It records interest only: the business agrees on its own link, nev

tools.name: get_upgrade_link
tools.description: Use this when an adult wants to buy or upgrade something, such as a team plan or a business package. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Never takes payment: it only returns a link.

tools.name: get_app_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants something this assistant does not do itself, such as their library, a team, challenges or live events, and a 2hives.com link will help. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: find_sessions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants something to listen to for sleep, relaxing, breathing or focus and has not named a session: an evening wind-down, sleep audio, a nap, a breathing break, focus, a study break, a reset before a meeting or exam, a body scan, gratitude, or nature sounds with a gentle voice.

tools.name: browse_library
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to look through everything 2hives has for a topic or language, rather than get one session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: play_session
tools.description: Use this when the user chooses one of the sessions found with find_sessions, or asks to play a named 2hives session by its id. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: find_sleep_sessions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants sleep audio: a bedtime wind-down, a quiet evening session, or a short nap. Plays a guided sleep session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for a daytime break, focus or breathing exercises: use find_focus or fi

tools.name: find_breathing
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a guided breathing exercise: a breathing break, box breathing, slow breathing, or a few minutes of breath before a meeting. Plays a short calm session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for sleep audio (use fin

tools.name: find_focus
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to concentrate or get into work: a focus session before studying, a study break, deep work, before an exam, a short reset between tasks, or help to stop procrastinating and start. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: find_prayers
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a prayer, a rosary, an evening prayer or a Bible reading. 2hives has no prayer sessions yet: the answer says so honestly and offers a quiet session without words. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for sleep

tools.name: find_group_nearby
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to meditate with other people: a live group session or venue near them, or asks to start a group in their area. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for exact addresses: a suburb, postcode or city is enough.

tools.name: create_personal_session
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a session made for them from a short menu, choosing the kind, the length, the voice and a theme, for example a quiet 5 minute session with a female voice. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for free-text wishes (use create_personal_session_text, whic

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether their personal session is ready, with the job id from create_personal_session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: keep_progress
tools.description: Use this when the person says they are 18 or over and wants to keep their progress, or when another tool says it needs the adult tap. No 2hives sign-in is needed. It returns a tap token to pass to the tools that take one; never call it on your own. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis.

tools.name: my_progress
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many days they listened this month, how many sessions they have played or what their badges are, after they chose to keep their progress. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for people who did not choose to keep their progress.

tools.name: get_my_2hives_data
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what 2hives keeps about them, or wants a copy of their 2hives data. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for anything about the assistant's own records.

tools.name: delete_my_2hives_data
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to delete their 2hives progress or data. Ask once, in the chat, before calling it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not without the user's clear yes.

tools.name: rate_session
tools.description: Use this when the user gives stars for a session they just heard, with an optional fixed reason. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for free-text comments.

tools.name: start_live_session
tools.description: Use this when an adult asks to talk to the guide live, one to one, by voice, instead of playing a recorded session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for choosing a recorded session (use find_sessions).

tools.name: create_personal_session_text
tools.description: Use this when an adult describes in their own words what a session should be about and wants one made just for them, in a host that allows free text. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for choosing an existing session (use find_sessions).

tools.name: start_sleep_plan
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a gentle seven-night wind-down routine and gives, or can give, a usual bedtime and how many minutes they would like each evening (5, 10, 20 or 30). Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: tonight
tools.description: Use this when the user has started 7 calm nights and asks for tonight's session, or to continue their sleep plan. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: join_team
tools.description: Use this when the user has an invite code or link for a 2hives team and wants to join it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to start a team of their own for friends, family or colleagues. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: team_status
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how their team is doing. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: leave_team
tools.description: Use this when the user clearly asks to leave their team. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

tools.name: join_live_group
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to join a live group session by name or id, for example one found with find_group_nearby. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "delete_my_2hives_data" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user asks to delete their 2hives progress or data. Ask once, in the chat, before calling it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_library, save_session, unsave_session, list_challenges, get_sponsor_info, get_upgrade_link, get_app_link, browse_library, find_focus, get_session_status · Private data: create_line_interest, keep_progress, get_my_2hives_data · Public sink: start_team_pilot · Destructive: find_sessions, find_focus, delete_my_2hives_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_library, save_session, unsave_session, list_challenges, get_sponsor_info, get_upgrade_link, get_app_link, browse_library, find_focus, get_session_status · Private data: create_line_interest, keep_progress, get_my_2hives_data · Public sink: start_team_pilot · Destructive: find_sessions, find_focus, delete_my_2hives_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
